assets.caption: 你好呀
assets.intent: Hello: body tilts slightly viewer-left; one antenna arches higher. UL raises its outer thread high in greeting; UR stays at shoulder height; LL and LR level the lower net so the crescent remains seated.

assets.caption: 收到
assets.intent: Received: body upright and composed, antennae make small forward dip. UL and UR hold outer threads at EVEN MIDDLE height; LL and LR steady a SMALL CENTERED net close to body. Restrained compact acknowledgment.

assets.caption: 谢谢你
assets.intent: Thank you: body bows forward in gratitude; antennae bend inward. UL and UR narrow upper rim; LL and LR gather lower sides against body without hiding grips. Moderate respectful bow, net gathered at middle height, not low apology crouch.

assets.caption: 没看懂
assets.intent: Confused: body tilts viewer-LEFT; antennae unequal arcs with one strongly curled. UL holds thread HIGHER than UR; LL and LR compensate below to keep crescent UPRIGHT in noticeably SKEWED net. Quizzical lopsided tilt, no question mark.

assets.caption: 搞定
assets.intent: Finished: body tall, star centered upright. UL and UR raise outer threads SYMMETRICALLY; LL and LR spread lower sides into WIDE LEVEL display of crescent. Proud symmetrical finished-work presentation.

assets.caption: 累了
assets.intent: Tired: body COMPRESSES VERTICALLY into low squat shape; antennae HANG to either side. All FOUR arms bend DOWN but retain SEPARATE grips; LOW net stays well above canvas edge with crescent visibly supported. Slumped exhausted, not tucked-in sleeping.

assets.caption: 想你了
assets.intent: Thinking of you: body leans toward CLOSE-HELD crescent; antennae curve INWARD. UL and UR draw upper threads toward window; LL and LR cradle lower net AGAINST body while preserving CLEAR GAP around star. Tender inward hug of net-held moon.

assets.caption: 晚安
assets.intent: Good night: body sinks behind the CLOSE net; both antennae droop outward. UL and UR lower outer threads; LL and LR pull lower side threads inward to deepen a snug DEEP hammock around the crescent. Quiet tucked-in sleeping posture without a face.
